base_branch.description: Branch to base a new branch on when the configured branch does not yet exist remotely (it is the first fallback source from which the new branch is created). Defaults to "main".

branch.description: Branchname to use for commits. When combined with branch_suffix the resulting branch is "<branch>-<branch_suffix>".

branch_suffix.description: Stable suffix appended to branch as "<branch>-<branch_suffix>". The value is supplied by you and must be the same for every plan/apply/refresh phase of a run, so the resulting branch name is identical across all phases. Generate it with a resource that persists its value in state (for example time_rotating with rotation_days = 1 for a daily branch) and reference that value here.

certificate_authority.description: Certificate authority to validate self-signed certificates.

ignore_updates.description: If true, any updates to resources of type git_repository_file will be ignored.

private_key.description: Private key used for authenticating to the Git SSH server.

append_timestamp.description: Whether to append a -YYYYMMDDHHMMSS timestamp suffix to the branch name.

computed_name.description: The final branch name after optional timestamp is appended.

source_branch.description: Branch to create from. Defaults to the provider-level branch config or main.

create.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

delete.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

read.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

update.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

timestamp_format.description: Go time package layout string for the timestamp suffix. Default: "20060102150405" (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS in 24-hour format).

branch.description: Branch to write the file to. Defaults to the provider-level branch config or main. Reference a git_repository_branch computed_name to target a per-run branch.
